scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n web,desktop -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm run typecheck -w cli
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w cli
